prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational. Create ONE SQUARE 2x2 atlas with four equal square cells for an adult vocabulary app. Attached image is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: restrained ink-and-watercolor educational illustrations, clear dark blue-charcoal outlines, pale blue wash, small warm natural color accents. Pure WHITE opaque background. Central 75% of each quadrant contains its subject with generous margins. Nothing crosses midlines. Leave horizontal 45–55% and vertical 47–53% center bands EMPTY WHITE. Natural human anatomy, recognizable objects, clear 320px silhouettes, restrained detail, no elaborate environment. NO captions, labels, writing, borders, grid lines, watermarks or logos. Only symbols or numerals explicitly requested in a cell are allowed. Meanings are guidance; never write them. Row-major fixed order. FOUR CELLS:
TOP LEFT — rattle (v.格格作响): A small tin containing several coins shakes from side to side, paired motion marks and small sound-wave strokes; no baby toy.
TOP RIGHT — thrifty (a.节俭的): An adult repairs a worn shirt and carefully puts saved coins into a jar instead of buying a new shirt shown in a thought bubble.
BOTTOM LEFT — nephew (n.侄子，外甥): A smiling uncle stands with his sibling and the sibling's young son, uncle gestures affectionately toward the boy; simple three-person family relationship.
BOTTOM RIGHT — bounce (v.弹起，跳起): A blue rubber ball hits the ground then springs upward, two faint sequential ball positions and curved blue up-down arrow.
review_notes: Rattle, thrifty, and bounce cells visually inspected and accepted. Nephew cell is superseded because the original three-person pose reads as a generic parent-child family and does not show the uncle relation clearly.
